_readme: ElevenLabs CLIENT tools for the browser /voice page, copied unchanged from the alex branch (contracts/tools.json market_tools and contracts/prepare_sandbox_buy.json at 081cd3a). The browser runs them: search_markets/get_orderbook call GET /api/public/market-tools/*, prepare_sandbox_buy calls POST /api/public/browser-trading/proposals with the in-memory session token. None of them can submit an order; approval is a separate typed-PIN action on screen. The agent must be private (authentication enabled) because sessions start from a server-issued signed URL.

tools.name: search_markets
tools.description: Find Gemini prediction market events and their contracts in the Gemini Sandbox, a test environment. Pass key words of the event or topic, or an empty string to list the active events. Returns events, each with a ticker, a title and contracts; each contract has a symbol, a label, an expiry and buy and sell prices for yes and no in dollars per contract, any of which may be null. Use an event's ticker as event_ticker and a contract's symbol as contract_symbol and as an order's instrument.

query.description: Key words of the event or topic, such as 'bitcoin' or 'fed'. Every word must match, so use few. An empty string lists the active events.

tools.name: get_orderbook
tools.description: Get a fresh Gemini Sandbox quote for one prediction contract: its buy and sell prices for yes and no in dollars per contract, any of which may be null. It is a quote, not a depth book. event_ticker is the event's ticker and contract_symbol is the contract's symbol, both copied exactly from a search_markets result in this conversation.

tools.name: prepare_sandbox_buy
tools.description: Prepare a sandbox buy for typed PIN approval. Send exactly one of quantity or budget_usd. The server sizes dollar budgets.

event_ticker.description: Exact event ticker returned by search

outcome.description: Requested prediction outcome, YES or NO.

quantity.description: Explicit whole-contract count. Omit when a dollar budget is given.

budget_usd.description: USD spending ceiling including estimated fees. Supply exactly one of budget_usd or quantity.
